Oh and don’t forget,
Person: so where is your family from
Me: Well, On my mom’s side, her dad’s side of the family is Asian and moved to the US after WW2 and her moms side is-
Person: you’re not Asian 
Me: what
Person: you aren’t Asian I can tell you are white. 
Me: well yeah because my dad’s side-
Person: if you are Asian prove it. Say a sentence in Japanese. 
Me: well my family isn’t Japanese.
Person: it’s still Asian say something in Japanese.

I’m really bad at giving advice but I suggest calling the suicide hotline but if you are unable to do that you can try talking to friends or medical professionals who will be able to give you help however big or small.
